directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-03: one judge for every check, reading one check list by branch
directive.quote: Turn all his checks into ONE generic check system; everything in lists, one generic process, the decision engine under it too, for any kind of thing: book, script, article, post.

job: check against a branch: read the rules and verdict rows of a branch from the person's check rows through the records door, then check with the one judge

distinct_from.why: The check itself (check, compileVerdictRules), unchanged; this file only reads a branch's rows and hands them to it.
Reads one decision step's check rows (questions asked of a step) by where; this file reads the rows judged on an artifact and leaves step rows out.
A caller: it imports checkABranch to run a book's checks branch before export; it reads no branch rows itself and judges nothing, so it is a user of this job, not a second owner.
A caller: tool:check-a-films-copy imports rulesOfBranch to get a film's checks branch, then reads the film's copy into units and hands both to the judge; it reads no branch rows itself.
This tool's own README, describing the branch mode (rulesOfBranch, checkABranch); documentation, not another owner.
The tool's command-line entry: when the request names a branch it imports checkABranch and prints its answer; a caller, not a second owner.
A test calling checkABranch over made-up rows to hold the answer's size; it tests this job, it does not do it.
The branch mode's tests, calling rulesOfBranch and checkABranch over made-up rows; they test this job, they do not do it.
